title: Croatian Stew
description: A hearty stew originating from Croatia, this recipe combines the rich flavors of the country with a hint of brininess.

ingredients.name: Wicked
ingredients.amount: 1 tsp (assuming a spice or condiment of similar name)

ingredients.name: Briny
ingredients.amount: 1/4 cup (assuming a type of liquid or marinade)

ingredients.name: Croatian
ingredients.amount: 2 tsp paprika (assuming a type of spice or seasoning)

ingredients.name: Stew
ingredients.amount: 1 can diced tomatoes (assuming a base for the stew)

instructions: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add 1 onion, diced, and cook until softened.
Add 2 cloves garlic, minced, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cabbage, wicked spice, and briny liquid. Cook until the cabbage is slightly tender.
Add the diced tomatoes, Croatian paprika, and 1 cup water. Stir to combine.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
